appliedUpdates.description: Added reusable targeted auth-broker commands (`auth_wildcard_handoff_targeted_test` and `auth_org_team_store_mode_targeted_test`) to `.factory/services.yaml` so the rerun issues have named validation hooks instead of handoff-only commands.

Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` to record that auth-broker startup now reports the org/team store mode, with missing `DATABASE_URL` explicitly surfaced as development-only in-memory mode and durable initialization failing closed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Explicitly carve out non-UI `apps/web` scaffold, typecheck, and validation-only fixes from the default routed-host `agent-browser` verification procedure.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `apps-web-scaffold-reproducible-typecheck-fix` worker legitimately completed a non-UI scaffold/typecheck fix with file/test/typecheck verification only, yet the current skill still reads as though routed-host browser verification is always expected for `apps/web` work.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Sanitize absolute repo, mission, and temp paths in handoff verification commands before calling `EndFeatureRun`, using placeholders such as `<repo-root>`, `<mission-dir>`, and `<tmp>`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `apps-web-scaffold-reproducible-typecheck-fix` handoff still embedded workstation-specific absolute paths in verification commands despite mission guidance already requiring repo-relative or sanitized path forms, which suggests the writeback path needs stronger procedural enforcement.
